name: Guilty As Charged!
source:
What makes a prisoner? How different are the people we lock up from the people doing the locking up?

Set in a dystopian world where even small crimes are punished in permanence, Guilty As Charged! sees 20-year-old Alan Pierce fight to the death in a televised gameshow between 18 criminals where the winner not only keeps their life, but gains a huge cash prize – as well as their freedom.

Play alongside Pierce as he explores the dingy prison around him, competes in brutal challenges, and makes bonds with the other captors. As rough and tough as they may seem, circumstances are often more complex than society portrays them...

[From [url=https://judgement-studios.itch.io/guilty-as-charged-proof-of-concept-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
是什么造就了囚犯？我们关押的人和负责锁押的人有什么不同？

故事发生在一个反乌托邦的世界里，即使是很小的罪行也会受到永久性的惩罚，《罪名成立》！20岁的艾伦·皮尔斯 (Alan Pierce) 在一场电视游戏节目中与18名罪犯进行殊死搏斗，获胜者不仅保住了自己的生命，还获得了巨额现金奖励以及自由。

与皮尔斯一起探索周围肮脏的监狱，参加残酷的挑战，并与其他绑架者建立联系。尽管看起来很艰难，但实际情况往往比社会所描绘的更为复杂……

[来自[url=https://judgement-studios.itch.io/guilty-as-charged-proof-of-concept-demo]itch.io[/url]]
